First publication occurred during author's lifetime, so the 25-year posthumous first-publication right does not apply. Any qualifying 1977 scientific/critical edition term of up to 30 years expired by 31 December 2007. https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/dir/2006/116/oj/eng
